name: Richard von Frankenberg
features: fair skin, dark hair receding, dark eyes behind spectacles, long thin face, slight build, wry intellectual expression
bio: Porsche's driver and Porsche's writer both — he founded Christophorus, the works magazine, in 1952 and edited it for years while racing 550 Spyders at Le Mans, the Mille Miglia and the Nürburgring. At Avus in 1956 his car went over the top of the north banking and he walked away, which very few did. A road accident killed him in 1973.
